summary: syrp-plugin-api (increment 3, final): the editor contract (Editor lifecycle, object-safe EditorHost, NodeHandle generational key, SizeConstraints, ParamHandles with gesture reporting through ParamGestures, EditorError), PluginDescriptor with per-format ids and categories, and PluginState with save_state/load_state in a versioned StateEnvelope; new codes SYRP-PLUGIN-0007 to 0011.
